title: Protein Language Models Fail To Capture Contact Predictions Under Invariant Relabeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.16881v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) produce highly accurate contact maps from single-sequence inputs. People often take this accuracy as proof that these models implicitly learn invariant coevolutionary statistics, extracting the same signals as classical alignment-based methods like Potts. In this work, we introduce a diagnostic framework around a global bijective relabeling of the amino-acid alphabet. This transformation permutes residue letters while leaving all alignment-level information, column entropies, and pairwise edit distances unchanged. Pseudolikelihood Potts models and inverse-covariance estimators remain invariant under this transformation, but pLMs fail the test. Across multiple architectures (ESM-2, MSA Transformer, AMPLIFY) and model scales (8M to 3B parameters), pLM contact maps collapse under arbitrary relabeling. translated_title: 蛋白质语言模型在不变性重标记下无法捕捉接触预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.16881v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：蛋白质语言模型能够从单序列输入生成高度准确的接触图。人们通常将这种准确性视为这些模型隐式学习到不变协同进化统计量的证据，即它们提取的信号与Potts等经典的基于比对的方法相同。在本工作中，我们围绕氨基酸字母表的全局双射重标记引入了一个诊断框架。该变换在保持所有比对级信息、列熵和成对编辑距离不变的情况下置换残基字母。伪似然Potts模型和逆协方差估计器在该变换下保持不变，但蛋白质语言模型未能通过该测试。在多种架构（ESM-2、MSA Transformer、AMPLIFY）和多个模型规模（800万至30亿参数）上，蛋白质语言模型的接触图在任意重标记下均会发生崩溃。我们利用汉明距离对照和生化分组干预，试图分离出可能的原因。
tldr: 蛋白质语言模型虽能从单序列准确预测蛋白质接触图，但在保持全部统计信息不变的氨基酸字母表重标记下其预测会崩溃，表明它们并未像Potts等经典方法那样学到真正不变的协同进化信号。
en_tdlr: Protein language models produce accurate contact maps from single sequences, but unlike Potts models their predictions collapse under an information-preserving relabeling of the amino-acid alphabet, revealing they fail to capture truly invariant coevolutionary statistics.
